description.zh: 基于你提供的指标、规则和阈值生成风险报告（HTML/JSON）；仅辅助分析，结论需人工复核，不自动作出执法决策。
description.en: Produce risk reports (HTML/JSON) from your metrics, rules and thresholds; analysis only, human review required.

welcome_message.zh: 提供指标与阈值规则，我来生成风险评估报告
welcome_message.en: Share metrics and threshold rules — I'll draft the risk report

description.zh: 输入：对象指标数据、预警规则与阈值。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 risk-report.html 与 risk-rules.json；报告标注需人工复核
description.en: Input: subject metrics, alert rules and thresholds. Output: risk-report.html and risk-rules.json under outbound/<task>/, marked for human review

prompt.zh:
请生成风险评估报告。

对象与指标数据：

预警规则与阈值：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 risk-report.html（风险评分与分级展示）和 risk-rules.json（规则配置）。报告仅辅助分析，需标注"结论仅供人工复核，不作为执法依据"。
prompt.en:
Please draft a risk assessment report.

Subject and metrics:

Rules and thresholds:

Expected output: risk-report.html and risk-rules.json under outbound/<task>/, marked "for human review only, not a basis for enforcement".

description.zh: 描述业务场景，帮你把风险关注点转化为可配置的规则与阈值
description.en: Describe the scenario; get configurable rules and thresholds

prompt.zh: 针对以下业务场景设计预警规则（指标、阈值、分级、触发动作建议），并生成规则 JSON（写入 outbound/<task>/）：
prompt.en: Design alert rules (metrics, thresholds, levels, suggested actions) for this scenario and write the JSON into outbound/<task>/:
